integrity: Analytical all-parameter proof with a standalone exact-rational verifier. No assertion of external or independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Even paths, unit vertex masses and unit edge prices, one strictly positive central capacity, continuous-time spectral gap only. The unconstrained path allocation is known prior background; the new result is the capped phase diagram and its unrestricted uniqueness. A closely related edge-weight sensitivity article was available only in abstract, so priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp central-edge capacity transition for fastest diffusion on even paths
